payload.title: Bind Data Parade into reference monitoring and the shared relevance Cyclotron
payload.description: Add publication data-parade to the papyrus-monitoring router config (CONFIG#router, MONITOR#hn) with the new backend AppSync endpoint and corpus knowledge-corpus-data-parade. Router stays in dry-run. The Cyclotron side already declares binding data-parade and pending output data-parade-relevance on standing run 566df5dc (target config). Open: the Data Parade criteria and classifier (pending from Ryan); do not flip the router to live until the output has a classifier. Relates to PPY-3212f1 and PPY-2d77c8.
